title.zh: Gleam doesn't compile to Erlang source anymore
title.en: Gleam doesn't compile to Erlang source anymore

current_state.zh: The Gleam compiler now targets Erlang's abstract format directly instead of generating Erlang source code, a significant internal change that improves tooling, error reporting, and compilation efficiency.
